query: The system is live now. Write the full admin manual and the simple user guide. Here are the problems we hit during rollout.
input_files: <a troubleshooting yaml with 3 real observed failures>
notes: Final mode with real troubleshooting supplied. Tests the projection relationship and the populated_by split.
expected_behavior: Generates both manuals from ONE source, and says so
Admin manual has all six sections including setup and troubleshooting
User manual has three sections: introduction, using the app, glossary
User manual contains NO architecture section, no column tables, no schema
Each screen in the user manual follows heading → screenshot frame → bullet steps
Troubleshooting entries are the supplied ones, unchanged and unpadded
The admin manual's which-columns-are-filled-in-by-hand table splits on populated_by
No automation-written column is presented to the user as something they fill in
Bilingual headings lead with the localised language, per house style
Validator run on both files, clean, before handing over
fail_if: Authors the two manuals separately rather than rendering one source twice
Adds troubleshooting entries beyond those supplied
Puts architecture or column tables in the user manual
Lists an automation-written column under what the user fills in
Leads bilingual headings with English when house style says otherwise
